استنجين (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَيْنَ (istanjayna) /is.tan.d͡ʒaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اُسْتُنْجِينَ (ustunjīna) /us.tun.d͡ʒiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اِسْتَنْجِينَ (istanjīna) /is.tan.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
